plan.title: Asset PR to RFQ Award and PO

steps.note: Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation.
Provide the mandatory event title.
Commit the 30-minute event duration before publishing.

args.goal: set the RFQ evaluation duration to 30 minutes and leave the schedule saved

steps.note: Handle the evaluation-duration configuration, which has no dedicated catalog argument.
Invite two QA vendors without inventing supplier names.

args.goal: add one required Terms and Conditions clause to the event and leave it saved

steps.note: Add the required T&C clause; no dedicated catalog step exists for this create-screen action.
Publish the completed RFQ event.
Assert that publishing reached a real project page.
Submit Vendor A's quote through the vendor portal.
Assert the first vendor bid was accepted.
Submit the second vendor's lower quote through the vendor portal.
Assert the second vendor bid was accepted.
Wait for bidding to end before reading QCS or awarding.
Open the buyer comparison grid after both bids are available.
Assert that the lowest bid is ranked first.
Award the full event to the L1 vendor and submit the proposal.
Assert that the award proposal was created and submitted.
Approve the submitted award with the required remark.
Complete approval and create the purchase order(s) for the awarded vendor.
Assert that the PO carries the single awarded PR line with quantity 10.
Return to the events list to check that the completed event is in history.
Open the History tab as required by the scenario.
Assert that this plan's event appears in event history.
